hook: All four engines lit. Then the test stopped early.
narration: All four engines on NASA's Moon rocket lit up, and then the test stopped after about a minute.
This was the Artemis I core stage, on a test stand in Mississippi, in January 2021.
The four RS-25 engines ignited successfully.
The stage is bolted to the stand, so the engines can run at full power without it going anywhere.
By this point the test was fully automated, with the onboard software watching every engine.
[short pause] Then the software stopped it early.
outcome: The onboard software shut all four engines down safely.
title: Moon rocket test stopped after a minute
description:
On Jan. 16, 2021, NASA hot fired the Artemis I Space Launch System core stage at Stennis Space Center in Mississippi. All four RS-25 engines ignited, and the automated test was stopped early after about a minute.
